QuestInfo.name: Pia and the Blue Mushroom
QuestInfo.1: Under the watchtower in #m10001050#, I saw Pia, who was wearing a teddy bear costume. How cute! She told me that she ran into a bully #o16# on her way to #m10002000#, and now she wants me to show the rude mushroom who's boss! I need to collect #b20 #t4000013#s#k and #b20 #t4000016#s#k to show her as evidence. I contemplated telling Pia she's basically asking to be teased, wandering around the forest in a teddy bear costume like that, but I decided against it.
QuestInfo.2: I delivered #b20 #t4000013#s#k and #b20 #t4000016#s#k to Pia in #m10001050#. She was thrilled that she got vengeance on the mushrooms and gave me a scroll for hat. All I have to do is click on it in the Use tab of my Item Inventory and drag it to my helmet in the Equipment window... Oh, and I'll have to cross my fingers and hope the scroll doesn't fail.

0.0: Whew... I had the most difficult time when I ran into a #o16# the other day. It was so frustrating! If only I had more strength... I would've showed them what for!
0.1: Whoa! You look pretty strong! How about you take care of those bullies for me? Bring me #b20 #t4000013#s#k and #b20 #t4000016#s#k as proof, and I'll give you something in return... Something really sweet! Yeah!

1.0: HEY! In your hand... Are those the #b#t4000013#s#k and #b#t4000016#s#k I asked for? You got so many! Thank you! I feel soo much better. Muahaha, take that, mushrooms. Right back at ya, punks!
1.1: Oh yeah. This isn't much, but take it. Great work!

yes.0: This scroll... I believe it can strengthen your helmet. It's easy to use too. Just open the Use tab of your Item Inventory, open your Equipment Inventory at the same time, then drag the scroll onto your helmet. There's a chance the scroll can fail, but life's risky like that...

item.0: I'll give you something really nice if you bring me #b20 #t4000013#s#k and #b20 #t4000016#s#k. I always keep my word! Honest!
